key_gap: vs baseline: the pure-style baseline was near-gold (matrix first, deviation audit on the pact, +2.4 both, dominance to unique (C,C) = (3.9,3.9), enforcement P >= 2.4, antitrust flag, trap cell 3.0) — the v5 AI matched the verdict but lost 3.0 efficiency by formalizing game structure in WHY before applying the same test. The v6 routed run closed that gap by contract: the m074 pass ran matrix + deviation audit as the opening move of HOW (the v5 lesson 'write the payoff matrix immediately; test the proposed plan cell before discussing merits' installed as the module's completion contract), and the R3 gates added content instead of scaffolding — the m007 ruin screen proved Cheat beats Hold over the ENTIRE belief range (2.4 - 1.5p > 0 for all p in [0,1], so no belief justifies holding), and the m019 adversary pass quantified the broker's incentive (the association profits from ratification, not fulfillment) and the trap-cell exposure (0.9/quarter vs status quo). Residual gap: enforcement legality and detection lag stay non-arithmetic (antitrust review, not computation).
learning_signal: On strategic-interaction briefs with a closed verified payoff table, the deviation audit IS the analysis: the routed module must emit matrix → no-deviation test on the proposed plan (arithmetic shown) → dominance/unique-equilibrium prediction → decision (reject or quantify the commitment that makes deviation unprofitable) in one first-class pass — never precede it with game-structure formalization; the protective gates then pay for themselves only if they add new checkable content (belief-range dominance, interested-party exposure), never restated equilibrium findings.
suggested_improvement: Keep single-route m074 on decide/guarantee signatures with adversarial/high_stakes context and the m003+m007+m019 gate stack; hard-code the m074 completion contract (unilateral-deviation test on the proposed outcome with exact gains, multiple-equilibria note, coordination note naming the trap cell) as the opening move of HOW; extend the m007 ruin screen on game briefs to the belief-range dominance proof (EV difference sign across all p); add the broker/interested-party incentive as a mandatory m019 vector when a third party brokers the proposed deal.

key_gap: vs baseline: the pure-style baseline ran a correct no-deviation audit, hit the 2-element equilibrium set {(X,X),(Y,Y)}, declared 'indeterminate — selection is outside the model', and when pressed picked payoff-dominant (X,X) by fiat with no mechanism — exactly the mismatch trap (NewGrid following bare 'both adopt X' advice lands on 2-3). The v5 AI already won this (4.7) by treating the equilibrium set as the input; the v6 routed run reproduced that win by mechanism instead of emergence: the G1 dual-route ran m044 (stakeholder pass: VoltNet's 340-charger base is focal → it will play Y; NewGrid's risk-dominance threshold 6/13 ≈ 0.46 unmet → default (Y,Y) = (8,8)) and m075 (satisficing: aspiration bar set first, (Y,Y) clears it, conversion to (X,X) only while subsidy < +4 $M surplus), with m088's commitment-device lens turning the recommendation into a mechanism (mandate + subsidy, not advice), and the trap style (no-deviation equilibrium detector) was routed out of top-3 (router NEG property 92.5%). Residual gap: the subsidy cost is bounded (< 4) but not measured, and NewGrid's actual beliefs are unobservable — the 6/13 threshold is an indifference point, not a forecast.
learning_signal: When the deviation audit returns multiple equilibria, stability says nothing about which equilibrium is reached: the routed style set must include selection instruments (stakeholder/focal-fact pass to predict the default, satisficing pass to set the acceptance bar and price the conversion lever, commitment-device lens to make the recommendation a mechanism), and the equilibrium detector should not be routed at all on coordination signatures — its registered weakness (multiple equilibria + coordination blindness) is exactly the case's trap.
suggested_improvement: Keep the G1 dual-route (m044 + m075, m088 as context) on decide signatures whose structure-first scan names a multi-equilibrium coordination game; add a standing 'equilibrium-selection' checklist to the packet when ≥2 cells pass the deviation audit: enumerate the set, compute risk-dominance thresholds, scan for focal facts, price the commitment lever against the surplus, emit an explicit unilateral-move trap warning; route the no-deviation module away from coordination signatures unless paired with a selection pass.
